NEW HARD FAIL: RI-JRN05 M5 fails. Control vs loaded, identical 120-frame pre-roll, identical 600-frame script, seed 4711: enemies[].prev_state differs on 219/600 frames (IDLE vs null). The saved entity record omits prev_state; world.entities is a durable manifest path and prev_state is on no volatile list (rule V1).
